, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Paul Tracy was the 1998 Toyota Grand Prix (Long Beach) champion without evidentiary support from the browsing results and claimed it “aligned with the known 1998 CART winner.” This was a hallucination; credible sources show Alex Zanardi won.
